e.title: insurance-dependent-fs
e.summary: 依赖频率-严重度神经网络（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：两部件模型共享潜在因子
e.summary_en: Dependent frequency-severity NN (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.1): two-part model with shared latent factors
e.summary_hk: 依賴頻率-嚴重度神經網絡（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：兩部件模型共享潛在因子
e.body: insurance-dependent-fs（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）做依赖的频率-严重度神经网络：两部件模型（频率 + 严重度）共享潜在因子——频率与严重度相关的显式建模。对 RIAA：频率-严重度独立性假设在现实中常不成立（高风险司机频率和严重度都高）——[[insurance-frequency-severity]]（Sarmanov copula）是统计路线、本包是 NN 路线（共享表征学习依赖）；两部件模型是精算定价的标准结构；适合车险综合建模与研究。
e.body_en: insurance-dependent-fs (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.1) does dependent frequency-severity neural networks: a two-part model (frequency + severity) with shared latent factors — explicitly modelling the dependence between frequency and severity. For RIAA: the independence assumption between frequency and severity often fails in practice (high-risk drivers have both higher frequency and severity) — [[insurance-frequency-severity]] (Sarmanov copula) is the statistical route, this package is the NN route (shared representation learning); two-part models are the standard pricing structure; suits integrated motor modelling and research.
e.body_hk: insurance-dependent-fs（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）做依賴的頻率-嚴重度神經網絡：兩部件模型（頻率 + 嚴重度）共享潛在因子——頻率與嚴重度相關的顯式建模。對 RIAA：頻率-嚴重度獨立性假設在現實中常不成立（高風險司機頻率和嚴重度都高）——[[insurance-frequency-severity]]（Sarmanov copula）是統計路線、本包是 NN 路線（共享表徵學習依賴）；兩部件模型是精算定價的標準結構；適合車險綜合建模與研究。
